summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against all five paragraphs of the selected Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the confession’s universal assertions, dialogue attribution, negative duties, retrospective obligation, repeated credibility claim, explicit conditions, and life-to-God ending. The simplified edition’s shorter sentences do not materially alter these claims. Reader-facing servant follows current policy; no repentance terminology occurs here. The notes retain the selected working reading while disclosing alternatives, conjecture, supplied text, gaps, mediated versions, and adapted quotations consistently with the supplied project reports. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to this working source and disclosure of those reports; it does not authenticate unseen images, certify external editions, establish a unique interpretation, or constitute exhaustive collation.
